capabilities: Preview verse text on hover or click in Reading view and Live Preview
Open the full chapter in a distraction-free reader with chapter navigation
Switch Bible translations from the popover
Detect full book names and abbreviations with or without verse ranges
Jump to any chapter via the 'Open Bible reference…' command
extras: README documents network use: verse text is fetched on demand from public Bible APIs (api.nlt.to, bolls.life, bible-api.com) and cached for the session; only the hovered reference is sent. No API key or setup required. Scripture credits and copyright notice included.
problem: Obsidian gives no content when hovering a Bible reference in a note, so readers must leave their notes to look the passage up.

relations.evidence: bolls.life — NIV, ESV, NKJV, NASB and most others (also the NLT fallback).
api.nlt.to — Tyndale's official NLT API, which carries the NLT's real section headings
Every preview and the chapter reader link to the passage on Bible Gateway.

summary: Bible reference previewer that shows verse text in a hover or tap popover and opens full chapters in a reader, with an inline translation switcher.
